def dt_format_to_regex(format_str):
    """Return a regex pattern string that matches a datetime string formatted with C strftime format string."""
    mapping = {
        '%Y': r'\d{4}',
        '%y': r'\d{2}',
        '%m': r'\d{2}',
        '%b': r'(Jan|Feb|Mar|Apr|May|Jun|Jul|Aug|Sep|Oct|Nov|Dec)',
        '%B': r'(January|February|March|April|May|June|July|August|September|October|November|December)',
        '%d': r'\d{2}',
        '%e': r'\d{1,2}',
        '%H': r'\d{2}',
        '%I': r'\d{2}',
        '%p': r'(AM|PM)',
        '%M': r'\d{2}',
        '%S': r'\d{2}',
        '%f': r'\d{1,6}',
        '%z': r'([+-]\d{4}|[+-]\d{2}:\d{2})',
        '%Z': r'\w+',
        '%%': r'%',
        # maybe others
    }
    # Use regex to find % directives
    # We'll iterate over format_str and replace each directive with mapping
    regex_parts = []
    i=0
    while i < len(format_str):
        if format_str[i] == '%':
            if i+1 >= len(format_str):
                raise ValueError('Incomplete format specifier at end')
            spec = format_str[i:i+2]
            if spec in mapping:
                regex_parts.append(mapping[spec])
            else:
                # For unknown spec, we can just escape literal
                # But better to raise ValueError
                raise ValueError('Unsupported datetime format code %s' % spec)
            i += 2
        else:
            # escape regex special characters
            if format_str[i] in r'.^$*+?{}[]\|()':
                regex_parts.append('\\' + format_str[i])
            else:
                regex_parts.append(format_str[i])
            i += 1
    return ''.join(regex_parts)
